A '''Republic command center''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]]. During a [[Battle of Thustra|battle]] there, this command center was headed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Tyffix]] and [[Tyr]]. Both were [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the command center was struck by a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] that was launched by the native [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]].
